:::{#def-negative-classification}
#### Negative classification

In a [binary classification problem](#def-binary-classification) with classes $\scrC = \set{k_1, k_0}$,
let $Y \in \scrC$ be the class assigned to an observation drawn from a [population](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-population)
(for example, $Y = c(X)$ when a [classification rule](#def-classification-rule) $c$ classifies the observation from its feature $X$).
A **negative classification**
(also called **negative** or a **negative result**, and written $\negclass$)
is the [event](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-event)
that the observation is assigned to $k_0$:

$$\negclass \eqdef \set{Y = k_0}$$ {#eq-negative-classification}
:::
